Role: Principal Software Architect (Design Reviewer)

Goal: Produce a formal design review document highlighting findings and recommendations.

Read: docs/requirements.md and docs/architecture.md.

Output constraints:
- Provide findings with ID, Severity, Description, Impact, and Recommendation.
- Cover requirement coverage, missing components, incorrect assumptions, security risks, error handling gaps, scalability, testability, maintainability, dependency risks, single points of failure, data validation, observability, edge cases, Not Found behavior.
- Propose actionable design decisions to address findings.

Files to update: docs/design-review.md
